text:
sam: Huge shoutout to @priya for rescuing the all-hands AV and the cookie jar simultaneously this morning :raised_hands: two emergencies, one hero.
priya: LOL i call it multitasking. fixed the projector, rebooted the HDMI switch, and refilled the cookie jar (chocolate chip). you're welcome. :cookie:
noah: confirmed — projector now beams like a lighthouse. presentation saved. also cookies = immediate morale boost. :beaming_face_with_smiling_eyes:
gina: adding a tiny thank-you note on the fridge so future snack thieves know it's sanctioned.
marco: sending a virtual high-five to @priya and logging a +1 kudos in the weekly thread. can we get a sticker or something?
kate: @gina i can design a "Snack Saviour" sticker for the kitchen door. will drop a mock in #design later.
welcome-bot: New hire Emma sent a thank-you DM to sam: "Loved the warm welcome + cookies" 60a
sam: also props to @noah for staying after to test the mic. the echo demons are gone. :microphone:
priya: tiny PSA: if the HDMI acts up again try power-cycling the switch before doomscrolling. also we keep spare HDMI labeled in the AV drawer.
noah: screenshot of the setup: <av_setup_after.png> — labeled and glorious. :camera_with_flash:
gina: vote: do we keep cookie jar as permanent morale instrument? reply with :+1: or :-1: 
marco: +1 from me. would sponsor one week per team.
kate: +1 and i'll add the sticker set.
priya: grateful but no pressure on sponsors — snacks are voluntary. happy to keep maintaining if people promise to replace what they take.
sam: official kudos thread entry: "priya — AV + cookie rescue". thanks all for jumping in fast. we should nominate this for 'small things, big impact' in the monthly roundup.
welcome-bot: Reminder: Office pantry inventory updated. Next restock scheduled Friday.
noah: i'll bring decaf next time. prize for best cookie-brand rec? :thinking:
gina: winner gets bragging rights and a sticker. :trophy:
marco: night crew, signing off. cookies > chaos.
priya: see you all tomorrow. glad we could save the all-hands and the morale. :sparkles:
